controls: RIFF/WAVE declared length must match actual file size; input must fit upload byte and duration limits.
Only PCM signed 16-bit input is accepted with channel count 1..8 and sample rate 8..48 kHz.
Block alignment, byte rate, nonempty sample-aligned data size and frame-derived duration are validated before ingest publishes output.
Upload byte count and SHA-256 are checked, and tampering/malformed source tests assert no transcript or normalized file is published.
17 new dimension tests cover channel counts 1/2/8, sample rates 8/16/48 kHz, and forged channels/rates, alignment, sample width and partial frames.

limitations: Validation supports bounded PCM/WAV only; other media types are rejected by this ingest worker.
